blurb: Hatteras Island’s only campground is located in the heart of Hatteras Village, in the scenic Outer Banks area of North Carolina. Set among beautiful canals and grassy fields, our resort has over 60 paved RV sites. We welcome “big rigs” with many sites featuring water, sewer and electric hookups, cable, and WiFi.
